potential_mechanisms_not_effect_sizes.deduction: Each private conversation receives its own problem/role/tool schemas and authorized observations; explicit communication and shared organization state add model-visible text.
potential_mechanisms_not_effect_sizes.uncertainty: Additional input overhead is plausible but cannot be quantified from tool count alone; actual per-task request usage must be measured.

potential_mechanisms_not_effect_sizes.deduction: A team spends the same5M/512 pool on repair, coordination, review and summaries.
potential_mechanisms_not_effect_sizes.uncertainty: More members do not automatically obtain more repair steps; actual budget allocation is dynamic, not5M divided equally byN.

potential_mechanisms_not_effect_sizes.deduction: REVIEW adds another member acceptance; PIPELINE/MATRIX add source-bound stage or dual-authority evidence.
potential_mechanisms_not_effect_sizes.uncertainty: These may detect mistakes or impose friction; configuration alone proves neither a score benefit nor a score penalty.

potential_mechanisms_not_effect_sizes.deduction: Only member001 final tree is exported; correct work left unmerged in another private tree does not count. A team can stop because no member has a reachable event or organization guard blocks progress.
potential_mechanisms_not_effect_sizes.uncertainty: Need actual event/merge/stop evidence to distinguish repair failure from coordination or integration failure.

potential_mechanisms_not_effect_sizes.deduction: Members take turns under one writer, while different teams run concurrently.
potential_mechanisms_not_effect_sizes.uncertainty: No within-team parallel wall-time gain follows from these roles; completion time also includes CPU tests, setup, memory pressure, scheduling and grading.
